title: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation
question: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, along with the department's full name and the school name, considering only departments that grant degrees and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments? Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS AVG_ENROLLED,
  VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS VARIANCE_ENROLLED,
  STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS STDDEV_ENROLLED
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME

(SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 CROSS
